description:
FILED s529b (Opus, 2026-10-31), found while inverse-verifying the #3870 guard (Pl/t/constant-scope-01.t).  PRE-EXISTING (main d8577478).  TOOLS layer (pl2cl's transpile client/server, task #1545), not the compiler.

THE MECHANISM: cl/pcl-runtime.lisp p-transpile-file spawns `perl -I D1 -I D2 ... pl2cl --module --deps F -- FILE` for a module cache miss (%p-transpile-inc-args: the program's @INC).  Pl/t/PCLCore.pm sets PCL_XSERVER for every gate row, and the variable is inherited by the sbcl the row runs, so that spawn is SERVED: the pl2cl client block (top of pl2cl, a BEGIN before `use lib`) sends argv + %ENV + cwd -- but NOT @INC -- to a server exec'd as `$^X $0 --xserver`.  pl2cl's own header names the hole ("What the name does NOT carry is perl's own switches ... No such caller sets PCL_XSERVER today") -- the runtime inside a gate row IS such a caller.  The server then extracts prototypes with ITS @INC: a `require Foo::Bar` inside the module, where Foo::Bar lives only in the program's `use lib` dir, is not found and contributes nothing.

REPRODUCER (the #3870 fixture; on main d8577478, before the #3870 fix): lib/C3870/A.pm = `package C3870::A; use strict; use constant _D => 0; sub new { print "debug-new\n" if _D; if (!$INC{'C3870/B.pm'}) { require C3870::B } return bless {}, shift } sub filter { no strict qw(vars) } 1;`, lib/C3870/B.pm = `package C3870::B; use strict; use constant _D => 1; 1;`, p.pl = `use lib '<abs lib>'; use C3870::A; C3870::A->new; print "made\n";`
  perl: made
  `pcl p.pl` (no PCL_XSERVER): debug-new / made   (the #3870 bug, reproduced)
  the same `pcl p.pl` from inside a Pl/t row (PCL_XSERVER inherited): made   -- the module transpile never saw C3870::B
So a gate row exercising a module whose compile depends on a sibling module in a `use lib` dir measures a DIFFERENT compile than a user gets.  Pl/t/constant-scope-01.t runs its pcl rows with `PCL_XSERVER=` (empty) for this reason.

FIX SHAPE (suggested, not designed): the client sends @INC (or the -I list: `@INC` minus the server's own default entries) in the request and the forked child sets @INC from it before the transpile; or the client declines (falls through to the ordinary path) whenever its @INC differs from the default perl @INC + pl2cl's own `use lib`.  Declining is free, guessing is not (pl2cl's own rule).  Guard: a Pl/t row that runs a program whose module compile needs a `use lib` sibling, with and without PCL_XSERVER, asserting identical CL.


=== DONE (s532d) ===
FIX (tools layer, pl2cl's client / server seam; emission of an ordinary run unchanged): the XCLIENT block appends `scalar(@INC), @INC` to the request (after the environment -- an older server reads the fields it knows and ignores these; the PCLXS2 tag is unchanged, so Pl/t/gate-cost-01.t's stand-in server still speaks it); the server's per-request CHILD splices the entries its own @INC lacks in front of the first entry the two lists share (perl's -I order: the -I block precedes PERL5LIB and the defaults; the server was started by the same perl under the same PERL5LIB, both in the socket key) and re-derives @perl_inc -- so Pl::Parser's inc_paths default and the emitted preamble see the caller's -I exactly as `perl -I D pl2cl` does.  Per request only: the child is a fork.
NOTE: the client serves a FILE argument only (`pl2cl --module < F` from stdin is declined and spawns) -- the runtime's call `perl -I D ... pl2cl --module --deps F -- FILE` is the served shape.
REPRODUCER -> BAR: scratch/s532d/pr/xs/ in the s532d worktree -- lib/XsA.pm `use XsB; sub go { return pr(@a) }`, lib/XsB.pm exports `pr ($)` (perl: XsA::go() is "B:2"); `perl -I lib pl2cl --module -- lib/XsA.pm` PCL_XSERVER unset vs set: base 06a4b8ba plain ("XsA" "pr" 4 "proto:$") vs served "unknown" (different bytes); tree: plain == served byte-identical, "proto:$".
GUARD: Pl/t/gate-cost-01.t rows 7-8 (served vs spawned, and the prototype reached the call), inverse-verified on 06a4b8ba.  The `PCL_XSERVER=` workarounds are DELETED from Pl/t/constant-scope-01.t (the C3870 rows) and Pl/t/imported-term-01.t (the #3143 module-unit row, which cited #3180 -- the same hole); both files pass under the gate's server.  tools/t/sbcl-prefix.t 48/48.
#3180 is this task's duplicate (same mechanism, filed s51x for imported-term-01.t): closed by the same commit.


=== COMPLETED (s536, reviewing session, 2026-11-08) === merged as MAIN-READY-75 33334fb1 (s532d); review probes perl -> main 0affbe86 -> tree (scratchpad p532d/a.pl): tree = perl; no live baseline row keys on this task (CLOSE-WITH-ROWS checked).
subject: GATE-ONLY DIVERGENCE: a SERVED pl2cl request (PCL_XSERVER, every Pl/t row) drops perl's -I switches, so the runtime's `perl -I DIR pl2cl --module` transpile of a module inside a gate row cannot find a module that only a `use lib` dir holds -- its prototypes are not merged, and the row tests a different compile than production
